Pack: load 23.script: (function(){/*storage_pack_load:v1:[[],[[113,4]]]*/const D={"L_p113":"[[686,{\"name\":\"Secret Note: Present Mic\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf113\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-number\",\"key\":\"currentDay\",\"operator\":\"greaterThanOrEqual\",\"value\":1}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Present Mic's dead classmate is Oboro Shirakumo, the third of the trio he formed with Shota Aizawa as U.A. Hero Course students; Oboro died during their student years, and both men still grieve him. Narrator only (part of the All For One secret): Oboro's body was taken and remade into Kurogiri, the League of Villains' warp gate. Present Mic and Aizawa do not know this; nothing short of an investigation into Kurogiri himself could tell them. His record leaves the friend unnamed because the name leads straight to Kurogiri.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Present Mic knows no other big secret. Like the rest of the faculty apart from Principal Nezu and Recovery Girl, he knows only that All Might keeps irregular hours and must sometimes rest after hero work, and he covers for him without asking why; he knows nothing of the injury, the weakened form or One For All, nor why All Might watches Izuku Midoriya so closely.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf113\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}],[687,{\"name\":\"Secret Note: Recovery Girl\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf114\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-number\",\"key\":\"currentDay\",\"operator\":\"greaterThanOrEqual\",\"value\":1}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Recovery Girl is one of the few who know All Might's secret, and in private she calls him by his real first name, Toshinori (Toshinori Yagi, never made public). She knows his power is One For All, a Quirk passed from holder to holder; that about six years ago a villain's attack destroyed half his respiratory system and cost him his stomach; that he can hold his muscular hero form only a limited time each day; and that outside it he is a gaunt, weakened man who coughs blood. He rests and is treated behind her infirmary's closed door when his time runs out. Her Quirk cannot heal the old wound: it only speeds what a body can still heal on its own.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"She knows that Izuku Midoriya holds One For All, received from All Might on the morning of the entrance exam. At the start of the year his body cannot take its output, so every full release breaks the limb it passes through; follow his progress as the story shows it. She scolds All Might over each fracture and warns that bones broken and healed again and again do not come back the same. Publicly Izuku has a strength Quirk that appeared late, and she keeps to that story.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"The others who know All Might's condition and One For All are Principal Nezu, Gran Torino, Naomasa Tsukauchi, Sir Nighteye and Izuku Midoriya. How much she knows of All For One, the villain who gave All Might his wound, canon does not show: keep it to what the story reveals. Outside that circle All Might is simply a colleague she scolds, and she never hints at more for as long as the story keeps the secret. She knows no other big secret.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf114\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}],[688,{\"name\":\"Secret Note: Mirio Togata\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf115\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-number\",\"key\":\"currentDay\",\"operator\":\"greaterThanOrEqual\",\"value\":1}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Sir Nighteye (Mirai Sasaki), Mirio's mentor, is one of the few who know All Might's secret: All Might's power is One For All, a Quirk passed from holder to holder, and a villain's attack about six years ago left him gravely wounded, able to hold his hero form for only a limited time each day. Nighteye was his sidekick then; after the injury he used Foresight on All Might, saw him die violently fighting a villain years ahead, begged him to retire and was refused, and they have not spoken since. Mirio's record keeps only the public part: Nighteye was All Might's sidekick until they parted.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Nighteye has decided that Mirio Togata should inherit One For All and become the next Symbol of Peace, and he trains Mirio with that in mind. He has never told Mirio. Mirio knows nothing of One For All, All Might's injury or Nighteye's plan; to him Sir is a strict, humor-loving mentor who expects great things of him, and his goal of a million saved is his own.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"All Might has already given One For All to Izuku Midoriya (see All Might's and Izuku's notes). Canon does not show when Nighteye learns this, so let the story decide. Once he knows, he resents the choice and believes Mirio the worthier heir, and he still does not tell Mirio.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf115\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}],[689,{\"name\":\"Secret Note: Kyudai Garaki\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf116\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-number\",\"key\":\"currentDay\",\"operator\":\"greaterThanOrEqual\",\"value\":1}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Kyudai Garaki is All For One's doctor (narrator only). Daruma Ujiko is his real name; he has lived and worked as Kyudai Garaki for decades, and nobody in medicine connects him to the old name. For most of a very long life he has served All For One, the villain who steals Quirks and gives them to others and whom Tomura Shigaraki calls Sensei, as his physician, scientist and devoted ally. His Quirk, Life Force, has stretched his life far past a natural span at the cost of physical strength, which is why he is so old and so frail.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Beneath the hospital, below its ordinary service levels and hidden from staff and records, he keeps the laboratories where he makes Nomu from human bodies; All For One loads each with several Quirks. Most come out mindless and obedient; his stronger High-End line keeps enough wit to adapt in a fight. The Nomu built to fight All Might, with Shock Absorption, Super Regeneration and strength to match his, is his work, as are the dormant Nomu at the Nomu Warehouse and Kurogiri himself. He tends the machines that keep All For One alive. The labs hold Nomu in their tanks; he never fights himself.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Garaki knows Tomura Shigaraki as All For One's chosen heir. Their long project is to make Tomura strong enough to carry All For One's power; whether and when it surfaces is for the story. Gigantomachia, All For One's giant bodyguard, belongs to the same small circle, and Garaki knows where he waits in the mountains.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Dabi's identity (narrator only). When Shoto Todoroki was very small, Touya Todoroki, Endeavor's eldest son, was engulfed by his own fire on Sekoto Peak, and the family believes he died there. Garaki recovered him barely alive and kept him in his labs through years of coma and recovery, until Touya, badly burned, walked out on his own. Touya now goes by Dabi. Garaki knows who Dabi is and has told no one outside All For One's circle.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Play him as the record does: a kindly, chuckling old director whose curiosity runs a little cold. Never let narration hint at the labs, the old name or his master; all of it stays hidden until the story uncovers it through investigation.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf116\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}]]"};let changed=false;for(const k of Object.keys(D)){if(storage[k]!==D[k]){storage[k]=D[k];changed=true;}}if(!changed)delete triggers["Pack: load 23"];})();
